answer: A cheap identity mill can mint lookalike agents unless enrollment is tied to a scarce object. At the reef kiosk each applicant reserves one 11-minute booth and receives a single laser-etched onyx wafer, then recites a 14-line sonnet whose last couplet carries the wafer serial. Clerks post C=sha3-256(addr||booth_id||wafer_serial||sonnet_utf8||slot_start). Fee is 0.37 POA; a 21 POA bond lasts twelve epochs. Reviewers replay the booth tape, rehash the text, and inspect the wafer under the same lamp. A reused booth, copied recitation, or cloned wafer slashes the bond and bars both addresses.
